experiments.name: Water and salt: guided virtual investigation
experiments.description: Follow the virtual actions, then inspect how much salt has dissolved.
experiments.notice: This guided activity runs only inside the software model. It is not an instruction to perform a real laboratory experiment.

steps.prompt: Select the virtual water bottle and pour some water into the beaker.
steps.success: The beaker now contains virtual water.

steps.prompt: Add the virtual sodium chloride sample to the same beaker.
steps.success: The salt sample is now in the beaker.

steps.prompt: Use the Mix action on the same beaker.
steps.success: Mixing was recorded. The simulation will now update the dissolving model.

steps.prompt: Wait for the model to dissolve at least 1 g of the salt, then inspect the vessel.
steps.success: The model confirms that at least 1 g of salt has dissolved.
